note: Carroll County KY does not zone its unincorporated land (county rejected zoning outside Carrollton). The city of Carrollton's zoning map is published only as a static document (2026-02 Zoning Map, a Google Doc), not as a queryable polygon service. Carroll County GIS portal (carroll.countygis.org) exposes no zoning layer; no ArcGIS REST zoning service found for Carrollton, Ghent, Worthville or Sanders.
